title.raw: 卷六十三 志第十五: 地理六 Volume 63 Treatises 16: Geography 6

sentences.zh: 湖廣等處行中書省，為路三十、州十三、府三、安撫司十五、軍三，屬府三，屬州十七，屬縣一百五十，管番民總管一。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat of Huguang and other regions comprised thirty routes, thirteen prefectures, three superior prefectures, fifteen pacification commissions, and three army commands, with three subordinate superior prefectures, seventeen subordinate prefectures, and one hundred fifty subordinate counties, and administered one native-official chieftaincy over frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang Branch Secretariat comprised thirty routes, thirteen prefectures, three fu-level prefectures, fifteen pacification commissions, and three military commands, with three fu, seventeen prefectures, and one hundred fifty counties under its jurisdiction, plus one native-official chieftaincy over frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 本省陸站一百處，水站七十三處。

translations.literal: Within this province there were one hundred land courier stations and seventy-three water courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: The province maintained one hundred land relay stations and seventy-three water relay stations.

translations.idiomatic: Surveillance Commission for Integrity Inspection, Jiangnan-Hubei Circuit

sentences.zh: 唐初為鄂州，又改江夏郡，又升武昌軍。

translations.literal: In early Tang it was E Prefecture; it was again changed to Jiangxia Commandery and again promoted to Wuchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tang it was E Prefecture, later renamed Jiangxia Commandery, then raised to the Wuchang army command.

translations.literal: Under Song it was Jinghu North Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it formed the northern circuit of Jinghu.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗末年，世祖南伐，自黃州陽羅洑，橫橋梁，貫鐵鎖，至鄂州之白鹿磯，大兵畢渡，進薄城下，圍之數月，既而解去，歸即大位。

translations.literal: In the last years of Emperor Xianzong of Yuan, the Founder campaigned south; from Yangluo Ford of Huangzhou he stretched bridges horizontally and ran iron chains as far as Bailu Rock off E Prefecture; the great army all crossed, advanced pressing against the city walls, besieged it for several months, then lifted the siege and withdrew; upon returning he immediately took the supreme throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the final years of Möngke's reign, the future Kublai campaigned south. From Yangluo Ford near Huangzhou he laid pontoon bridges and ran iron chains across to Bailu Rock off Ezhou; the main force crossed in full, pressed to the walls, and besieged the city for months before withdrawing. On his return he soon took the throne.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，丞相伯顏從陽羅洑南渡，權州事張晏然以城降，自是湖北州郡悉下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, Chancellor Bayan crossed south from Yangluo Ford; Zhang Yanran, acting in prefectural affairs, surrendered the city, and from then on all prefectures and districts of Hubei were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 11 Chancellor Bayan crossed south from Yangluo Ford; Zhang Yanran, who held interim charge of the prefecture, surrendered the city, and thereafter every prefecture and district in Hubei fell.

sentences.zh: 是年，立荊湖等路行中書省，並本道安撫司。

translations.literal: That year the Branch Secretariat of Jinghu and other routes was established, together with the pacification commission of this circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jinghu Branch Secretariat was established, absorbing the circuit pacification commission.

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year a record-keeping office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year a record-keeping office was established.

sentences.zh: 十四年，立湖北宣慰司，改安撫司為鄂州路總管府，並鄂州行省入潭州行省。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Hubei Pacification Commission was established; the pacification commission was changed to the general superintendency of Ezhou Route, and the Ezhou Branch Secretariat was merged into the Tanzhou Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the Hubei Pacification Commission was set up; the pacification office became the general superintendency of Ezhou Route, and the Ezhou branch secretariat was merged into that of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年，遷潭州行省于鄂州，移宣慰司於潭州。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Tanzhou Branch Secretariat was moved to Ezhou, and the Pacification Commission was moved to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Tanzhou branch secretariat was relocated to Ezhou and the pacification commission to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十九年，隨省處例罷宣慰司，本路隸行省。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, following the precedent for places with a branch secretariat, the Pacification Commission was abolished, and this route was placed under the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, by the usual rule where a branch secretariat sat, the pacification commission was abolished and the route came directly under the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大德五年，以鄂州首來歸附，又世祖親征之地，改武昌路。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade, because Ezhou had been the first to submit and was also a place where the Founder had campaigned in person, it was renamed Wuchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 5, because Ezhou had been the first to submit and was where Kublai had campaigned in person, it was renamed Wuchang Route.

translations.idiomatic: It originated as Yongxing County under the Sui.

translations.literal: Hanyang: in the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan it was promoted to a middle-grade county.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyang: in Zhiyuan 22 it was raised to middle-grade county status.

sentences.zh: 唐初為歸州，又改巴東郡，又復為歸州。

translations.literal: In early Tang it was Gui Prefecture, again changed to Badong Commandery, and again restored as Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tang it was Gui Prefecture, later Badong Commandery, then restored as Gui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋端平三年，元兵至江北，遂遷郡治于江南曲沱，次新灘，又次白沙南浦，今州治是也。

translations.literal: In the third year of Duanping of Song, when Yuan troops reached the north bank of the Yangzi, the prefectural seat was moved to Qutuo south of the river in Jiangnan, then to Xintan, then to Baisha Nanpu; the present prefectural seat is this.
translations.idiomatic: In Song Duanping 3, as Yuan forces reached the north bank of the Yangzi, the seat was moved south to Qutuo on the Jiangnan shore, then to Xintan, then to Baisha Nanpu—the present seat dates from that relocation.

translations.idiomatic: It submitted at the opening of the Deyou era.

sentences.zh: 大德三年，立征東行省，未幾罷。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade the Eastern Campaign Branch Secretariat was established, but was soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 3 the Eastern Campaign Branch Secretariat was established, then soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 至治元年復立，命高麗國王為左丞相。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi it was restored, and the king of Goryeo was appointed left grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 1 it was restored, and the king of Goryeo was appointed left grand councillor.

translations.literal: Its affairs are recorded in the Goryeo Biography.
translations.idiomatic: Its affairs are recorded in the Goryeo Biography.

sentences.zh: 至元十八年，王睶言：「本國置站凡四十，民畜凋弊。」

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan, King Chungnyeol reported: "Our kingdom has altogether forty relay stations, and the people and livestock are exhausted."
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 18 King Chungnyeol reported: "Our kingdom maintains forty relay stations, and the people and livestock are exhausted."

translations.literal: An edict ordered them consolidated into twenty stations.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them consolidated into twenty stations.

sentences.zh: 三十年，沿海立水驛，自耽羅至鴨綠江並楊村、海口凡三十所。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year coastal water relay stations were established from Tamna to the Yalu River, including Yangcun and Haikou, thirty stations in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year thirty coastal water relay stations were established from Tamna to the Yalu River, including Yangcun and Haikou.

sentences.zh: 瀋陽等路高麗軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Shenyang Circuit Goryeo Military-Civilian General Superintendency.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang Circuit Goryeo Military-Civilian General Superintendency.

translations.literal: Agricultural promotion commissioners of each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Agricultural promotion commissioners of each circuit.

translations.literal: Established in the fifth year of Dade.
Appendix on the Source of the Yellow River
translations.idiomatic: Appendix on the Source of the Yellow River

translations.literal: The source of the Yellow River was not recorded in antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: The source of the Yellow River was unknown in antiquity.

translations.literal: The Yugong guides the river only from Jishi.
translations.idiomatic: The Yugong guides the river only from Jishi.

sentences.zh: 漢使張騫持節，道西域，度玉門，見二水交流，發蔥嶺，趨于闐，匯鹽澤，伏流千里，至積石而再出。

translations.literal: Han envoy Zhang Qian, bearing credentials, traveled the Western Regions, crossed Yumen Pass, and saw two rivers join, issuing from Congling, running toward Khotan, gathering in the Salt Lake, flowing underground for a thousand li, and emerging again at Jishi.
translations.idiomatic: The Han envoy Zhang Qian, bearing credentials, traveled the Western Regions, crossed Yumen Pass, and saw two rivers join. They issued from Congling, ran toward Khotan, gathered in the Salt Lake, flowed underground for a thousand li, and emerged again at Jishi.

sentences.zh: 唐薛元鼎使吐蕃，訪河源，得之于悶磨黎山。

translations.literal: Tang envoy Xue Yuanding was sent to Tibet to inquire after the river's source and found it on Mount Wenmoli.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang envoy Xue Yuanding was sent to Tibet to inquire after the river's source and found it on Mount Wenmoli.

sentences.zh: 然皆曆歲月，涉艱難，而其所得不過如此。

translations.literal: Yet all these expeditions took years and braved hardship, and what they obtained was no more than this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet all these expeditions took years, braved hardship, and learned no more than this.

sentences.zh: 世之論河源者，又皆推本二家。

translations.literal: Later writers on the river's source all traced their accounts back to these two traditions.
translations.idiomatic: Later writers on the river's source all traced their accounts to these two traditions.

sentences.zh: 其說怪迂，總其實，皆非本真。

translations.literal: Their theories are fanciful and circuitous; in sum, none reflects the true source.
translations.idiomatic: Their theories are fanciful and circuitous; in sum, none reflects the true source.

sentences.zh: 意者漢、唐之時，外夷未盡臣服，而道未盡通，故其所往，每迂回艱阻，不能直抵其處而究其極也。

translations.literal: Presumably in Han and Tang times the outer tribes had not all submitted, and the routes were not fully open, so travelers had to take roundabout and difficult paths and could not reach the place directly to investigate its farthest point.
translations.idiomatic: Presumably in Han and Tang times the outer tribes had not all submitted and routes were not fully open, so travelers had to take roundabout, difficult paths and could not reach the source directly.

sentences.zh: 元有天下，薄海內外，人跡所及，皆置驛傳，使驛往來，如行國中。

translations.literal: When the Yuan held all under heaven, relay stations were placed wherever people could reach within the seas and beyond, and envoys traveled between stations as if moving within the realm.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuan held all under heaven, relay stations were placed wherever people could reach, and envoys traveled between them as if moving within the realm.

sentences.zh: 至元十七年，命都實為招討使，佩金虎符，往求河源。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Zhiyuan the emperor appointed Duosu pacification commissioner, invested him with a gold tiger tally, and sent him to seek the river's source.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 17 the emperor appointed Duosu pacification commissioner, invested him with a gold tiger tally, and sent him to seek the river's source.

sentences.zh: 都實既受命，是歲至河州。

translations.literal: Once Duosu received his commission, that year he reached He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Once Duosu received his commission, he reached He Prefecture that year.

sentences.zh: 州之東六十里，有寧河驛。

translations.literal: Sixty li east of the prefecture was Ninghe Relay Station.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty li east of the prefecture lay Ninghe Relay Station.

sentences.zh: 驛西南六十里，有山曰殺馬關，林麓穹隘，舉足浸高，行一日至巔。

translations.literal: Sixty li southwest of the station was a mountain called Shama Pass; its forests and ravines were deep and narrow, and with every step one climbed higher; after one day's travel one reached the summit.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty li southwest of the station stood Shama Pass; its forests and ravines were deep and narrow, and with every step one climbed higher. After one day's travel one reached the summit.

sentences.zh: 西去愈高，四閱月，始抵河源。

translations.literal: Traveling westward, the land rose ever higher; after four months he finally reached the river's source.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling westward, the land rose ever higher; after four months he finally reached the river's source.

sentences.zh: 是冬還報，並圖其城傳位置以聞。

translations.literal: That winter he returned to report, and submitted maps of the relay stations and their positions.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he returned to report and submitted maps of the relay stations and their positions.

sentences.zh: 其後翰林學士潘昂霄從都實之弟闊闊出得其說，撰為《河源志》。

translations.literal: Later Hanlin Academician Pan Angxiao obtained the account from Duosu's younger brother Kuokuochu and compiled the Record of the River Source.
translations.idiomatic: Later Hanlin Academician Pan Angxiao obtained the account from Duosu's younger brother Kuokuochu and compiled the Record of the River Source.

sentences.zh: 臨川硃思本又從八里吉思家得帝師所藏梵字圖書，而以華文譯之，與昂霄所志，互有詳略。

translations.literal: Linchuan Zhu Siben also obtained Sanskrit maps preserved by the Imperial Preceptor in the Balijisi family, translated them into Chinese, and his account and Pan Angxiao's record differ in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben of Linchuan also obtained Sanskrit maps preserved by the Imperial Preceptor in the Balijisi family, translated them into Chinese, and his account and Pan Angxiao's record differ in detail.

sentences.zh: 今取二家之書，考定其說，有不同者，附注於下。

translations.literal: Now taking the books of both authors, I have examined and fixed their accounts; where they differ, notes are appended below.
translations.idiomatic: The accounts of both authors are here examined and reconciled; where they differ, notes are appended below.

sentences.zh: 按河源在土蕃朵甘思西鄙，有泉百餘泓，沮洳散渙，弗可逼視，方可七八十里，履高山下瞰，燦若列星，以故名火敦腦兒。

translations.literal: According to the source, the river rises in the western borderlands of Tibetan Do-Kham, where more than a hundred springs spread across marshy ground and cannot be approached closely; the area spans seventy or eighty li; from a high mountain one looks down and they glitter like arranged stars, hence the name Huodunnao'er.
translations.idiomatic: According to the source, the river rises in the western borderlands of Tibetan Do-Kham, where more than a hundred springs spread across marshy ground and cannot be approached closely. The area spans seventy or eighty li; from a high mountain one looks down and they glitter like arranged stars, hence the name Huodunnao'er.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「河源在中州西南，直四川馬湖蠻部之正西三千餘里，雲南麗江宣撫司之西北一千五百餘里，帝師撒思加地之西南二千餘里。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "The river's source lies southwest of the Central Provinces, directly west of the Mapu tribal region of Sichuan, more than three thousand li away; northwest of Yunnan's Lijiang Pacification Commission by more than fifteen hundred li; and southwest of the Imperial Preceptor's Sasijia territory by more than two thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "The river's source lies southwest of the Central Provinces, directly west of Sichuan's Mapu tribal region, more than three thousand li away; northwest of Yunnan's Lijiang Pacification Commission by more than fifteen hundred li; and southwest of the Imperial Preceptor's Sasijia territory by more than two thousand li.

translations.literal: The water gushes from the ground like wells.
translations.idiomatic: The water gushes from the ground like wells.

sentences.zh: 其井百餘，東北流百餘里，匯為大澤，曰火敦腦兒。」

translations.literal: There are more than a hundred such wells; flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, they gather into a great lake called Huodunnao'er."
translations.idiomatic: There are more than a hundred such wells; flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, they gather into a great lake called Huodunnao'er."

sentences.zh: 群流奔輳，近五七里，匯二巨澤，名阿剌腦兒。

translations.literal: The streams rush together; within five or seven li they gather into two great lakes named Alanao'er.
translations.idiomatic: The streams rush together; within five or seven li they gather into two great lakes named Alanao'er.

sentences.zh: 自西而東，連屬吞噬，行一日，迤邐東騖成川，號赤賓河。

translations.literal: From west to east they connect and merge; after one day's travel they stretch eastward into a river called the Chibin River.
translations.idiomatic: From west to east they connect and merge; after one day's travel they stretch eastward into a river called the Chibin River.

sentences.zh: 又二三日，水西南來，名亦裏出，與赤賓河合。

translations.literal: After two or three more days a river came from the southwest named Yilichu and joined the Chibin River.
translations.idiomatic: After two or three more days a river came from the southwest named Yilichu and joined the Chibin River.

sentences.zh: 又三四日，水南來，名忽闌。

translations.literal: After three or four more days a river came from the south named Hulan.
translations.idiomatic: After three or four more days a river came from the south named Hulan.

sentences.zh: 又水東南來，名也裏術，合流入赤賓，其流浸大，始名黃河，然水猶清，人可涉。

translations.literal: Another river came from the southeast named Yelishu; the combined streams entered the Chibin, the flow grew larger, and it was first called the Yellow River, though the water was still clear and men could wade it.
translations.idiomatic: Another river came from the southeast named Yelishu; the combined streams entered the Chibin, the flow grew larger, and it was first called the Yellow River, though the water was still clear and men could wade it.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「忽闌河源，出自南山。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "The Hulan River's source rises in the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "The Hulan River's source rises in the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 其地大山峻嶺，綿亙千里，水流五百餘里，注也裏出河。

translations.literal: In that region great mountains and steep ridges extend for a thousand li; the river flows more than five hundred li and enters the Yelishu River.
translations.idiomatic: In that region great mountains and steep ridges extend for a thousand li; the river flows more than five hundred li and enters the Yelishu River.

sentences.zh: 也裏出河源，亦出自南山。

translations.literal: The Yelishu River's source also rises in the southern mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The Yelishu River's source also rises in the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 西北流五百餘里，始與黃河合。」

translations.literal: Flowing northwest for more than five hundred li, it first joins the Yellow River."
translations.idiomatic: Flowing northwest for more than five hundred li, it first joins the Yellow River."

sentences.zh: 又一二日，歧為八九股，名也孫斡論，譯言九渡，通廣五七里，可度馬。

translations.literal: After one or two more days it divided into eight or nine channels named Yesunwolun, translated as "Nine Fords," five or seven li wide, passable on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: After one or two more days it divided into eight or nine channels named Yesunwolun, translated as "Nine Fords," five or seven li wide and passable on horseback.

sentences.zh: 又四五日，水渾濁，土人抱革囊，騎過之。

translations.literal: After four or five more days the water turned muddy; local people crossed by riding inflated hide bags.
translations.idiomatic: After four or five more days the water turned muddy; local people crossed by riding inflated hide bags.

sentences.zh: 聚落糾木幹象舟，傅髦革以濟，僅容兩人。

translations.literal: Settlements bound wooden poles into raft-like boats, covered them with hides to cross, and they held only two men.
translations.idiomatic: Settlements bound wooden poles into raft-like boats, covered them with hides to cross, and they held only two men.

sentences.zh: 自是兩山峽束，廣可一里、二里或半裏，其深叵測。

translations.literal: From this point two mountains hemmed in the river; it was one, two, or half a li wide, and unfathomably deep.
translations.idiomatic: From this point two mountains hemmed in the river; it was one, two, or half a li wide, and unfathomably deep.

sentences.zh: 朵甘思東北有大雪山，名亦耳麻不莫剌，其山最高，譯言騰乞裏塔，即昆侖也。

translations.literal: Northeast of Do-Kham is a great snow mountain named Yierimabamola; it is the highest mountain, translated as Tengqilita, that is, Kunlun.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of Do-Kham is a great snow mountain named Yierimabamola; it is the highest mountain, translated as Tengqilita—that is, Kunlun.

sentences.zh: 山腹至頂皆雪，冬夏不消。

translations.literal: From mid-slope to summit it is all snow, which never melts in winter or summer.
translations.idiomatic: From mid-slope to summit it is all snow, which never melts in winter or summer.

sentences.zh: 土人言，遠年成冰時，六月見之。

translations.literal: Local people say that in years long past, when ice formed, it could still be seen in the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: Local people say that in years long past, when ice formed, it could still be seen in the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 自八九股水至昆侖，行二十日。

translations.literal: From the eight or nine channels to Kunlun is twenty days' travel.
translations.idiomatic: From the eight or nine channels to Kunlun is twenty days' travel.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「自渾水東北流二百餘里，與懷裏火禿河合。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "From where the muddy water flows northeast for more than two hundred li, it joins the Huaili Huotu River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "From where the muddy water flows northeast for more than two hundred li, it joins the Huaili Huotu River.

sentences.zh: 懷裏火禿河源自南山，水正北偏西流八百餘里，與黃河合，又東北流一百餘里，過郎麻哈地。

translations.literal: The Huaili Huotu River rises in the southern mountains; its waters flow north with a slight bend west for more than eight hundred li and join the Yellow River; then flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, they pass Langmaha.
translations.idiomatic: The Huaili Huotu River rises in the southern mountains; its waters flow north with a slight bend west for more than eight hundred li and join the Yellow River, then flow northeast for more than a hundred li and pass Langmaha.

sentences.zh: 又正北流一百餘里，乃折而西北流二百餘里，又折而正北流一百餘里，又折而東流，過昆侖山下，番名亦耳麻不莫剌。

translations.literal: Flowing due north for more than a hundred li, it then turns northwest for more than two hundred li, then turns due north for more than a hundred li, then turns east, passes below Kunlun Mountain—its Tibetan name is Yierimabamola.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing due north for more than a hundred li, it then turns northwest for more than two hundred li, then due north for more than a hundred li, then east, passing below Kunlun Mountain—its Tibetan name is Yierimabamola.

sentences.zh: 其山高峻非常，山麓綿亙五百餘里，河隨山足東流，過撒思加闊即、闊提地。」

translations.literal: The mountain is extraordinarily high and steep; its foothills extend more than five hundred li; the river follows the mountain's base eastward, passing Sasijia, Kuoji, and Kuoti."
translations.idiomatic: The mountain is extraordinarily high and steep; its foothills extend more than five hundred li; the river follows the mountain's base eastward, passing Sasijia, Kuoji, and Kuoti."

sentences.zh: 河行昆侖南半日，又四五日，至地名闊即及闊提，二地相屬。

translations.literal: The river ran south of Kunlun for half a day; after four or five more days it reached places named Kuoji and Kuoti, the two adjoining each other.
translations.idiomatic: The river ran south of Kunlun for half a day; after four or five more days it reached places named Kuoji and Kuoti, the two adjoining each other.

sentences.zh: 又三日，地名哈剌別裏赤兒，四達之沖也，多寇盜，有官兵鎮之。

translations.literal: After three more days it reached a place named Halabielichier, a crossroads where many bandits roamed and government troops were stationed to guard it.
translations.idiomatic: After three more days it reached Halabielichier, a crossroads where many bandits roamed and government troops were stationed.

translations.literal: About two days northward, the river passed it.
translations.idiomatic: About two days northward, the river passed it.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「河過闊提，與亦西八思今河合。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "After the river passed Kuoti, it joined the Yixibasijin River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "After the river passed Kuoti, it joined the Yixibasijin River.

sentences.zh: 亦西八思今河源自鐵豹嶺之北，正北流凡五百餘里，而與黃河合。」

translations.literal: The Yixibasijin River rises north of Tiebao Ridge; flowing due north for more than five hundred li, it joins the Yellow River."
translations.idiomatic: The Yixibasijin River rises north of Tiebao Ridge; flowing due north for more than five hundred li, it joins the Yellow River."

sentences.zh: 昆侖以西，人簡少，多處山南。

translations.literal: West of Kunlun the population is sparse; most live south of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: West of Kunlun the population is sparse; most live south of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 山皆不穹峻，水亦散漫，獸有髦牛、野馬、狼、麅、羱羊之類。

translations.literal: The mountains are not lofty and steep, the waters are scattered, and the beasts include yak, wild horses, wolves, roe deer, and argali.
translations.idiomatic: The mountains are not lofty and steep, the waters are scattered, and the beasts include yak, wild horses, wolves, roe deer, and argali.

sentences.zh: 其東，山益高，地亦漸下，岸狹隘，有狐可一躍而越之處。

translations.literal: To the east the mountains grow higher and the land slopes downward; the banks narrow, and in places a fox could leap across.
translations.idiomatic: To the east the mountains grow higher and the land slopes downward; the banks narrow, and in places a fox could leap across.

sentences.zh: 行五六日，有水西南來，名納鄰哈剌，譯言細黃河也。

translations.literal: After five or six days' travel a river came from the southwest named Nalinhala, translated as "Lesser Yellow River."
translations.idiomatic: After five or six days' travel a river came from the southwest named Nalinhala, translated as "Lesser Yellow River."

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「哈剌河自白狗嶺之北，水西北流五百餘里，與黃河合。」

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "The Hala River rises north of Baigou Ridge; its waters flow northwest for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "The Hala River rises north of Baigou Ridge; its waters flow northwest for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River."

sentences.zh: 又兩日，水南來，名乞兒馬出。

translations.literal: After two more days a river came from the south named Qiermachu.
translations.idiomatic: After two more days a river came from the south named Qiermachu.

translations.literal: The two rivers joined and flowed into the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The two rivers joined and flowed into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「自哈剌河與黃河合，正北流二百餘里，過阿以伯站，折而西北流，經昆侖之北二百餘里，與乞裏馬出河合。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "From where the Hala River joins the Yellow River, it flows due north for more than two hundred li, passes Aiyibo Station, turns northwest, runs north of Kunlun for more than two hundred li, and joins the Qilimachu River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "From where the Hala River joins the Yellow River, it flows due north for more than two hundred li, passes Aiyibo Station, turns northwest, runs north of Kunlun for more than two hundred li, and joins the Qilimachu River.

sentences.zh: 乞裏馬出河源自威、茂州之西北，岷山之北，水北流，即古當州境，正北流四百餘里，折而西北流，又五百餘里，與黃河合。」

translations.literal: The Qilimachu River rises northwest of Wei and Mao prefectures, north of Mount Min; its waters flow north—the ancient Dang Prefecture region—due north for more than four hundred li, then turn northwest for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River."
translations.idiomatic: The Qilimachu River rises northwest of Wei and Mao prefectures, north of Mount Min; its waters flow north through the ancient Dang Prefecture region, due north for more than four hundred li, then turn northwest for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River."

sentences.zh: 河水北行，轉西流，過昆侖北，一向東北流，約行半月，至貴德州，地名必赤裏，始有州治官府。

translations.literal: The river flowed north, then turned west, passed north of Kunlun, and flowed steadily northeast; after about half a month it reached Guide Prefecture, at a place named Bichili, where prefectural government first appeared.
translations.idiomatic: The river flowed north, then turned west, passed north of Kunlun, and flowed steadily northeast; after about half a month it reached Guide Prefecture, at a place named Bichili, where prefectural government first appeared.

sentences.zh: 州隸吐蕃等處宣慰司，司治河州。

translations.literal: The prefecture was subordinate to the Pacification Commission of Tibetan Regions and other places, whose seat was at He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture was subordinate to the Pacification Commission of Tibetan Regions and other places, whose seat was at He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又四五日，至積石州，即《禹貢》積石。

translations.literal: After four or five more days it reached Jishi Prefecture, that is, the Jishi of the Yugong.
translations.idiomatic: After four or five more days it reached Jishi Prefecture—the Jishi of the Yugong.

translations.literal: After five days it reached Anxiang Pass in He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After five days it reached Anxiang Pass in He Prefecture.

translations.literal: After one day it reached Daluo Hollow.
translations.idiomatic: After one day it reached Daluo Hollow.

sentences.zh: 東北行一日，洮河水南來入河。

translations.literal: Traveling northeast for one day, the Tao River came from the south and entered the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling northeast for one day, the Tao River came from the south and entered the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「自乞裏馬出河與黃河合，又西北流，與鵬拶河合。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "From where the Qilimachu River joins the Yellow River, it flows northwest and joins the Pengza River.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "From where the Qilimachu River joins the Yellow River, it flows northwest and joins the Pengza River.

sentences.zh: 鵬拶河源自鵬拶山之西北，水正西流七百餘里，過劄塞塔失地，與黃河合。

translations.literal: The Pengza River rises northwest of Pengza Mountain; its waters flow due west for more than seven hundred li, pass Zhasaitadi, and join the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Pengza River rises northwest of Pengza Mountain; its waters flow due west for more than seven hundred li, pass Zhasaitadi, and join the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 折而西北流三百餘里，又折而東北流，過西寧州、貴德州、馬嶺凡八百餘里，與邈水合。

translations.literal: Turning northwest for more than three hundred li, then northeast for more than eight hundred li, it passes Xining Prefecture, Guide Prefecture, and Maling.
translations.idiomatic: Turning northwest for more than three hundred li, then northeast for more than eight hundred li, it passes Xining Prefecture, Guide Prefecture, and Maling.

sentences.zh: 邈水源自青唐宿軍穀，正東流五百餘里，過二巴站與黃河合，又東北流，過土橋站古積石州來羌城、廓州構米站界都城凡五百餘里，過河州與野龐河合。

translations.literal: It joins the Miao River. The Miao River rises in the garrison valley of Qingtang Sujun; flowing due east for more than five hundred li, it passes Erba Station and joins the Yellow River; then flowing northeast, it passes Tubiao Station, the old Jishi Prefecture, Laicheng of Qiang, the boundary of Kuomi Station in Huozhou, and the capital city for more than five hundred li; it passes He Prefecture and joins the Yepang River.
translations.idiomatic: It joins the Miao River. The Miao River rises in the garrison valley of Qingtang Sujun; flowing due east for more than five hundred li, it passes Erba Station and joins the Yellow River; then flowing northeast, it passes Tubiao Station, old Jishi Prefecture, Laicheng of Qiang, the boundary of Kuomi Station in Huozhou, and the capital city for more than five hundred li; it passes He Prefecture and joins the Yepang River.

sentences.zh: 野龐河源自西傾山之北，水東北流凡五百餘里，與黃河合。

translations.literal: The Yepang River rises north of Mount Xiqing; its waters flow northeast for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Yepang River rises north of Mount Xiqing; its waters flow northeast for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又東北流一百餘里，過踏白城銀川站與湟水、浩亹河合。

translations.literal: Flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, it passes Tabai City and Yinchuan Station and joins the Huang and Hao Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, it passes Tabai City and Yinchuan Station and joins the Huang and Hao Rivers.

sentences.zh: 湟水源自祁連山下，正東流一千餘里，注浩亹河。

translations.literal: The Huang River rises below Qilian Mountain; flowing due east for more than a thousand li, it enters the Hao River.
translations.idiomatic: The Huang River rises below Qilian Mountain; flowing due east for more than a thousand li, it enters the Hao River.

sentences.zh: 浩亹河源自刪丹州之南刪丹山下，水東南流七百餘里，注湟水，然後與黃河合。

translations.literal: The Hao River rises south of Shandan Prefecture, below Shandan Mountain; its waters flow southeast for more than seven hundred li, enter the Huang River, and then join the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Hao River rises south of Shandan Prefecture, below Shandan Mountain; its waters flow southeast for more than seven hundred li, enter the Huang River, and then join the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又東北流一百餘里，與洮河合。

translations.literal: Flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, it joins the Tao River.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing northeast for more than a hundred li, it joins the Tao River.

sentences.zh: 洮河源自羊撒嶺北，東北流，過臨洮府凡八百餘里，與黃河合。」

translations.literal: The Tao River rises north of Yangsa Ridge; flowing northeast and passing Lintao Prefecture for more than eight hundred li, it joins the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Tao River rises north of Yangsa Ridge; flowing northeast and passing Lintao Prefecture for more than eight hundred li, it joins the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又一日，至蘭州，過北卜渡。

translations.literal: After one more day it reached Lan Prefecture and crossed Beibu Ford.
translations.idiomatic: After one more day it reached Lan Prefecture and crossed Beibu Ford.

sentences.zh: 至鳴沙州，過應吉裏，正東行。

translations.literal: It reached Mingsha Prefecture, passed Yingjili, and traveled due east.
translations.idiomatic: It reached Mingsha Prefecture, passed Yingjili, and traveled due east.

sentences.zh: 至寧夏府南，東行，即東勝州，隸大同路。

translations.literal: South of Ningxia Prefecture it traveled eastward to Dongsheng Prefecture, subordinate to Datong Route.
translations.idiomatic: South of Ningxia Prefecture it traveled eastward to Dongsheng Prefecture, subordinate to Datong Route.

sentences.zh: 自發源至漢地，南北澗溪，細流傍貫，莫知紀極。

translations.literal: From the source to Han territory, ravines and brooks ran north and south with tributary streams joining from the sides beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: From the source to Han territory, ravines and brooks ran north and south with tributary streams joining from the sides beyond count.

sentences.zh: 山皆草石，至積石方林木暢茂。

translations.literal: The mountains were all grass and rock; only at Jishi did forests flourish.
translations.idiomatic: The mountains were all grass and rock; only at Jishi did forests flourish.

sentences.zh: 世言河九折，彼地有二折，蓋乞兒馬出及貴德必赤裏也。

translations.literal: The world says the river makes nine bends; in that region there are two bends, namely at Qiermachu and at Bichili in Guide.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition says the river makes nine bends; in that region there are two bends, namely at Qiermachu and at Bichili in Guide.

sentences.zh: 思本曰：「自洮水與河合，又東北流，過達達地，凡八百餘里。

translations.literal: Zhu Siben says: "From where the Tao River joins the Yellow River, it flows northeast through Tatar territory for more than eight hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Siben says: "From where the Tao River joins the Yellow River, it flows northeast through Tatar territory for more than eight hundred li.

sentences.zh: 過豐州西受降城，折而正東流，過達達地古天德軍中受降城、東受降城凡七百餘里。

translations.literal: Passing Feng Prefecture and the Western Surrender City, it turns due east, passes through Tatar territory, the old Central Surrender City of Tiande Army, and the Eastern Surrender City for more than seven hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Feng Prefecture and the Western Surrender City, it turns due east, passes through Tatar territory, the old Central Surrender City of Tiande Army, and the Eastern Surrender City for more than seven hundred li.

sentences.zh: 折而正南流，過大同路雲內州、東勝州與黑河合。

translations.literal: Turning due south, it passes Yunnei Prefecture of Datong Route, Dongsheng Prefecture, and joins the Hei River.
translations.idiomatic: Turning due south, it passes Yunnei Prefecture of Datong Route, Dongsheng Prefecture, and joins the Hei River.

sentences.zh: 黑河源自漁陽嶺之南，水正西流，凡五百餘里，與黃河合。

translations.literal: The Hei River rises south of Yuyang Ridge; its waters flow due west for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Hei River rises south of Yuyang Ridge; its waters flow due west for more than five hundred li and join the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又正南流，過保德州、葭州及興州境，又過臨州，凡一千餘里，與吃那河合。

translations.literal: Flowing due south, it passes Baode Prefecture, Jia Prefecture, and Xing Prefecture, then passes Lin Prefecture for more than a thousand li and joins the China River.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing due south, it passes Baode Prefecture, Jia Prefecture, and Xing Prefecture, then passes Lin Prefecture for more than a thousand li and joins the China River.

sentences.zh: 吃那河源自古宥州，東南流，過陝西省綏德州，凡七百餘里，與黃河合。

translations.literal: The China River rises in the old You Prefecture; flowing southeast and passing Suide Prefecture of Shaanxi Province for more than seven hundred li, it joins the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The China River rises in the old You Prefecture; flowing southeast and passing Suide Prefecture of Shaanxi Province for more than seven hundred li, it joins the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又南流三百里，與延安河合。

translations.literal: Flowing south for three hundred li, it joins the Yan'an River.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south for three hundred li, it joins the Yan'an River.

sentences.zh: 延安河源自陝西蘆子關亂山中，南流三百餘里，過延安府，折而正東流三百里，與黃河合。

translations.literal: The Yan'an River rises in the chaotic mountains at Luzi Pass in Shaanxi; flowing south for more than three hundred li and passing Yan'an Prefecture, it turns due east for three hundred li and joins the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan'an River rises in the chaotic mountains at Luzi Pass in Shaanxi; flowing south for more than three hundred li and passing Yan'an Prefecture, it turns due east for three hundred li and joins the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又南流三百里，與汾河合。

translations.literal: Flowing south for three hundred li, it joins the Fen River.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south for three hundred li, it joins the Fen River.

sentences.zh: 汾河源自河東朔、武州之南亂山中，西南流，過管州，冀甯路汾州，霍州，晉甯路絳州，又西流，至龍門，凡一千二百餘里，始與黃河合。

translations.literal: The Fen River rises in the chaotic mountains south of Shuozhou and Wuzhou in Hedong; flowing southwest, it passes Guan Prefecture, Fen Prefecture of Jining Route, Huo Prefecture, Jiang Prefecture of Jinning Route, then flows west to Longmen for more than twelve hundred li before first joining the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Fen River rises in the chaotic mountains south of Shuozhou and Wuzhou in Hedong; flowing southwest, it passes Guan Prefecture, Fen Prefecture of Jining Route, Huo Prefecture, Jiang Prefecture of Jinning Route, then flows west to Longmen for more than twelve hundred li before first joining the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又南流二百里，過河中府，遇潼關與太華大山綿亙，水勢不可復南，乃折而東流。

translations.literal: Flowing south for two hundred li, it passes Hezhong Prefecture; encountering Tong Pass and the great mountains of Mount Taihua stretching across its path, the current could no longer flow south and so turned east.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south for two hundred li, it passes Hezhong Prefecture; encountering Tong Pass and the great mountains of Mount Taihua stretching across its path, the current could no longer flow south and so turned east.

sentences.zh: 大概河源東北流，所曆皆西番地，至蘭州凡四千五百餘里，始入中國。

translations.literal: In general the river's source flows northeast through Tibetan territory; to Lan Prefecture is more than four thousand five hundred li before it enters China.
translations.idiomatic: In general the river's source flows northeast through Tibetan territory; to Lan Prefecture is more than four thousand five hundred li before it enters China.

sentences.zh: 又東北流，過達達地，凡二千五百餘里，始入河東境內。

translations.literal: Flowing northeast through Tatar territory for more than two thousand five hundred li, it first enters Hedong territory.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing northeast through Tatar territory for more than two thousand five hundred li, it first enters Hedong territory.

sentences.zh: 又南流至河中，凡一千八百餘里。

translations.literal: Flowing south to Hezhong is more than eighteen hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing south to Hezhong is more than eighteen hundred li.

translations.literal: In all it totals more than nine thousand li."
translations.idiomatic: In all it totals more than nine thousand li."

sentences.zh: 至元二十年，立畏兀兒四處站及交鈔庫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Zhiyuan four relay stations and paper-money treasuries were established in Uyghur territory.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 20 four relay stations and paper-money treasuries were established in Uyghur territory.

sentences.zh: 諸王海都行營于阿力麻裏等處，蓋其分地也。

translations.literal: The princes' mobile imperial encampment was at Alimali and other places, being their allotted domains.
translations.idiomatic: The princes' mobile imperial encampment was at Alimali and other places, being their allotted domains.

sentences.zh: 自上都西北行六千里，至回鶻五城，唐號北庭，置都護府。

translations.literal: From the Upper Capital, traveling northwest six thousand li, one reaches the five cities of the Uyghurs; Tang called it Beiting and established a protectorate.
translations.idiomatic: From the Upper Capital, traveling northwest six thousand li, one reaches the five cities of the Uyghurs; the Tang called it Beiting and established a protectorate.

sentences.zh: 又西北行四五千里，至阿力麻裏。

translations.literal: Traveling northwest another four or five thousand li, one reaches Alimali.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling northwest another four or five thousand li, one reaches Alimali.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，海都叛，舉兵南來，世祖逆敗之於北庭，又追至阿力麻裏，則又遠遁二千餘里。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan Haidu rebelled and marched south; the Founding Emperor met and defeated him at Beiting, then pursued him to Alimali, where he fled more than two thousand li farther away.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 5 Haidu rebelled and marched south; Kublai met and defeated him at Beiting, then pursued him to Alimali, where he fled more than two thousand li farther away.

sentences.zh: 上令勿追，以皇子北平王統諸軍于阿力麻裏以鎮之，命丞相安童往輔之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered pursuit halted and placed Prince Beiping in command of the armies at Alimali to guard the region, appointing Chancellor Antong to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered pursuit halted and placed Prince Beiping in command of the armies at Alimali to guard the region, appointing Chancellor Antong to assist him.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，授八撒察裏虎符，掌別失八里畏兀城子裏軍站事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan Basachali was invested with a tiger tally to manage military relay affairs in the Uyghur city of Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 15 Basachali was invested with a tiger tally to manage military relay affairs in the Uyghur city of Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以萬戶綦公直戍別失八里。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the ten-thousand-household commander Qi Gongzhi garrisoned Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the ten-thousand-household commander Qi Gongzhi garrisoned Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從諸王阿只吉請，自大和嶺至別失八里置新站三十。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, at the request of Prince Azhiji, thirty new relay stations were established from Daheling to Beshbalik.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, at Prince Azhiji's request, thirty new relay stations were established from Daheling to Beshbalik.

sentences.zh: 二十年，立別失八里和州等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Pacification Commission of Beshbalik, He Prefecture, and other places was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Pacification Commission of Beshbalik, He Prefecture, and other places was established.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，阿只吉使來言：「元隸只必帖木兒二十四城之中，有察帶二城置達魯花赤，就付闊端，遂不隸省。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Prince Azhiji's envoy reported: "Of the twenty-four cities originally subordinate to Zhibietebmu'er, two Chaidai cities had darughachi appointed and were handed over to Kuoetuan, so they no longer belonged to the province."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Prince Azhiji's envoy reported: "Of the twenty-four cities originally subordinate to Zhibietebmu'er, two Chaidai cities had darughachi appointed and were handed over to Kuoetuan, so they no longer belonged to the province."

sentences.zh: 至是奉旨：「誠如所言，其還正之。」

translations.literal: At this an edict stated: "If this is indeed so, restore the proper arrangement."
translations.idiomatic: At this an edict stated: "If this is indeed so, restore the proper arrangement."

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遣侍衛新附兵千人屯田別失八里，置元帥府，即其地以總之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year a thousand newly attached guardsmen were sent to garrison and farm at Beshbalik; a marshal's headquarters was established there to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year a thousand newly attached guardsmen were sent to garrison and farm at Beshbalik; a marshal's headquarters was established there to command them.

sentences.zh: 至元十五年，授朵魯知金符，掌彰八里軍站事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan Duoluzhi was invested with a gold tally to manage military relay affairs at Zhangbali.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 15 Duoluzhi was invested with a gold tally to manage military relay affairs at Zhangbali.

sentences.zh: 太宗甲午年，命諸王拔都征西域欽義、阿速、斡羅思等國。

translations.literal: In the jiawu year of Taizong, the imperial princes were ordered; Prince Batu was sent to campaign in the Western Regions against the Qinyi, Asud, Rus, and other states.
translations.idiomatic: In Ögedei's jiawu year (1234), Batu was ordered to campaign in the Western Regions against the Qinyi, Asud, Rus, and other peoples.

translations.literal: In the yiwei year, Möngke was also ordered to go there.
translations.idiomatic: In the following yiwei year (1235), Möngke was likewise ordered to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 歲丁酉，師至寬田吉思海傍，欽義酋長八赤蠻逃避海島中，適值大風，吹海水去而幹，生禽八赤蠻，遂與諸王拔都征斡羅思，至也列贊城，七日破之。

translations.literal: In the dingyou year the army reached beside the Caspian Sea; the Qinyi chieftain Bachman fled to an island in the sea. A great wind happened to blow the seawater away until dry, and Bachman was captured alive. Thereupon, together with Prince Batu, they campaigned against Rus, reached the city of Riazan, and took it in seven days.
translations.idiomatic: In dingyou (1237) the army reached the Caspian shore. The Qinyi chieftain Bachman fled to a sea island, but a gale blew the water back and left the seabed dry, and he was taken alive. Batu then marched against Rus, besieged Riazan, and captured it in seven days.

sentences.zh: 歲丁巳，出師南征，以駙馬剌真之子乞反為達魯花赤，鎮守斡羅思、阿思。

translations.literal: In the dingsi year an army marched south on campaign; Qifan, son of the imperial son-in-law Lazhen, was appointed darughachi to garrison Rus and As.
translations.idiomatic: In dingsi (1257) troops marched south on campaign; Qifan, son of the imperial son-in-law Lazhen, was made darughachi to garrison Rus and As.

sentences.zh: 歲癸丑，括斡羅思、阿思戶口。

translations.literal: In the guichou year the households of Rus and As were registered.
translations.idiomatic: In guichou (1253) a census registered the households of Rus and As.

sentences.zh: 吉利吉思、撼合納、謙州、益蘭州等處。

translations.literal: Kirghiz, Khanhe Na, Qian Prefecture, Yilan Prefecture, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Kirghiz, Khanhe Na, Qian Prefecture, Yilan Prefecture, and related territories.

sentences.zh: 吉利吉思者，初以漢地女四十人，與烏斯之男結婚，取此義以名其地。

translations.literal: As for Kirghiz: at first forty women from Han lands married men of Wus; taking this meaning, they named the place.
translations.idiomatic: Kirghiz takes its name from a founding legend: forty Han women were married to men of Wus, and the land was named from that union.

translations.literal: It lies more than ten thousand li south of Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: It lies more than ten thousand li south of Dadu.

sentences.zh: 相傳乃滿部始居此，及元朝析其民為九千戶。

translations.literal: Tradition holds that the Naiman tribe first dwelt here; under the Yuan dynasty its people were divided into nine thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Tradition says the Naiman first settled here; the Yuan divided the population into nine thousand households.

sentences.zh: 其境長一千四百里，廣半之，謙河經其中，西北流。

translations.literal: Its territory is one thousand four hundred li long and half that in width; the Kem River runs through it, flowing northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The region is about 1,400 li long and half as wide; the Kem River runs through it toward the northwest.

sentences.zh: 又西南有水曰阿浦，東北有水曰玉須，皆巨浸也，會於謙，而注於昴可剌河，北入於海。

translations.literal: Farther southwest is a body of water called Apu; northeast is a body of water called Yuxu—both great lakes. They meet at Kem and empty into the Angara River, which enters the sea to the north.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lies Lake Apu and to the northeast Lake Yuxu; both are large lakes. They join the Kem, which flows into the Angara and then north to the sea.

translations.literal: Its customs differ from those of other states.
translations.idiomatic: Local customs differ from those of neighboring peoples.

translations.literal: Its language is the same as that of the Uighurs.
translations.idiomatic: The language is the same as Uighur.

sentences.zh: 廬帳而居，隨水草畜牧，頗知田作，遇雪則跨木馬逐獵。

translations.literal: They dwell in felt tents, follow grass and water in herding livestock, know something of farming, and when snow falls ride wooden horses to hunt.
translations.idiomatic: They live in felt tents, move with pasture and water while herding, practice some agriculture, and in snow use wooden skis to hunt.

translations.literal: Local products include famous horses and white and black gyrfalcons.
translations.idiomatic: Notable products include fine horses and white and black gyrfalcons.

sentences.zh: 昴可剌者，因水為名，附庸于吉利吉思，去大都二萬五千餘里。

translations.literal: Angara is named for its river; it is a dependency of Kirghiz and lies more than twenty-five thousand li from Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Angara, named for its river, was subject to Kirghiz and lay more than 25,000 li from Dadu.

sentences.zh: 其語言與吉利吉思特異。

translations.literal: Its language differs markedly from that of Kirghiz.
translations.idiomatic: Its language differed markedly from Kirghiz.

sentences.zh: 晝長夜短，日沒時炙羊肋熟，東方已曙矣，即《唐史》所載骨利斡國也。

translations.literal: Days are long and nights short; when the sun sets and mutton ribs are roasted done, dawn has already broken in the east. This is the Guli Gan state recorded in the Tang histories.
translations.idiomatic: Days are long and nights short: mutton ribs roasted at sunset are done by the time dawn breaks in the east. This is the Guli Gan country recorded in Tang histories.

sentences.zh: 烏斯亦因水為名，在吉利吉思東，謙河之北。

translations.literal: Wus is also named for its river; it lies east of Kirghiz and north of the Kem River.
translations.idiomatic: Wus, likewise named for its river, lay east of Kirghiz and north of the Kem.

sentences.zh: 其俗每歲六月上旬，刑白馬牛羊，灑馬湩，咸就烏斯沐漣以祭河神，謂其始祖所從出故也。

translations.literal: Its custom is that in the first ten days of the sixth month each year white horses, cattle, and sheep are sacrificed, mare's milk is sprinkled, and all go to bathe in the Wus River to worship the river god, because they say their ancestors came forth from it.
translations.idiomatic: Each year in early sixth month they sacrifice white horses, cattle, and sheep, sprinkle mare's milk, and bathe in the Wus River to worship the river god, whom they regard as the source of their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 撼合納猶言布囊也，蓋口小腹巨，地形類此，因以為名。

translations.literal: Khanhe Na means 'cloth sack'; the land is narrow at the mouth and broad in the belly, and the terrain resembles this, so it was named accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Khanhe Na means 'cloth sack': the terrain is narrow at one end and broad at the other, like a sack, hence the name.

sentences.zh: 在烏斯東，謙河之源所從出也。

translations.literal: It lies east of Wus, where the source of the Kem River issues forth.
translations.idiomatic: It lies east of Wus, at the headwaters of the Kem.

sentences.zh: 其境上惟有二山口可出入，山水林樾，險阻為甚，野獸多而畜字少。

translations.literal: Within its borders only two mountain passes allow entry and exit; mountains, rivers, forests, and groves make the terrain extremely rugged; wild beasts are many and domestic livestock few.
translations.idiomatic: Only two mountain passes give access; rugged mountains, rivers, and forest make travel difficult; game is abundant but livestock scarce.

sentences.zh: 貧民無恆產者，皆以樺皮作廬帳，以白鹿負其行裝，取鹿乳，采松實，及劚山丹、芍藥等根為食。

translations.literal: Poor people without fixed property all make felt tents of birch bark, load their baggage on white deer, take deer milk, gather pine nuts, and dig the roots of lily and peony for food.
translations.idiomatic: Impoverished people without fixed holdings live in birch-bark tents, pack goods on tame white deer, drink deer milk, gather pine nuts, and eat lily and peony roots.

translations.literal: In the month they also mount wooden horses to go hunting.
translations.idiomatic: In winter they also hunt on wooden skis.

sentences.zh: 謙州亦以河為名，去大都九千里，在吉利吉思東南，謙河西南，唐麓嶺之北，居民數千家，悉蒙古、回紇人。

translations.literal: Qian Prefecture is also named for its river; it lies nine thousand li from Dadu, southeast of Kirghiz and southwest of the Kem River, north of Tang's Lu Ridge. Several thousand households dwell there, all Mongols and Uighurs.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Prefecture, named for the Kem, lay 9,000 li from Dadu southeast of Kirghiz and southwest of the Kem, north of the Lu Ridge. Several thousand households lived there, mostly Mongols and Uighurs.

sentences.zh: 有工匠數局，蓋國初所徙漢人也。

translations.literal: There are several craft offices—Han people relocated in the founding of the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Several craft bureaus were staffed by Han people relocated at the dynasty's founding.

sentences.zh: 地沃衍宜稼，夏種秋成，不煩耘耔。

translations.literal: The land is fertile and suitable for grain; summer planting yields an autumn harvest without need for hoeing or weeding.
translations.idiomatic: The soil is rich and easily farmed; crops planted in summer ripen in autumn without hoeing or weeding.

translations.literal: Some say Wang Khan first dwelt in this place.
translations.idiomatic: Some say Wang Khan first settled here.

sentences.zh: 初，州境山中居人，見一巨蛇，長數十步，從穴中出飲河水，腥聞數里，因以名州。

translations.literal: At first, mountain dwellers within the prefecture saw a huge snake dozens of paces long emerge from a cave to drink river water; its stench could be smelled for several li, and the prefecture was named from this.
translations.idiomatic: Legend says mountain dwellers once saw a giant snake dozens of paces long leave its cave to drink from the river; its stench carried for li, and the prefecture was named accordingly.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，詔遣劉好禮為吉利吉思撼合納謙州益蘭州等處斷事官，即于此州修庫廩，置傳舍，以為治所。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan an edict dispatched Liu Haoli as judicial commissioner for Kirghiz, Khanhe Na, Qian Prefecture, Yilan Prefecture, and other places; at this prefecture he built granaries and relay lodges to serve as the seat of administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7 Liu Haoli was appointed judicial commissioner over Kirghiz, Khanhe Na, Qian, and Yilan; he built granaries and relay stations at Yilan as his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 先是，數部民俗，皆以杞柳為杯皿，刳木為槽以濟水，不解鑄作農器，好禮聞諸朝，乃遣工匠，教為陶冶舟楫，土人便之。

translations.literal: Previously, in several departments the people customarily used willow for cups and bowls, hollowed wood for troughs to draw water, and did not know how to cast farm tools. Haoli reported this at court, and craftsmen were sent to teach pottery, boat-building, and the like; the natives found this convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, locals made cups from willow and water troughs from hollowed logs and knew no metal farming tools. Haoli reported this to court, craftsmen were sent to teach pottery and boat-building, and the people benefited.

translations.literal: Appendix on Annam commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 陳氏叛服之跡，已見本傳，今取其城邑之可紀者，錄于左方。

translations.literal: The Chen clan's record of rebellion and submission appears in the main biography; here the notable walled towns are selected and recorded below.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen house's cycles of rebellion and submission are treated in the main biography; notable walled settlements are listed here.
Daluocheng Route: the Han Jiaozhi commandery.

translations.literal: Under Tang the Protectorate General of Annan was established.
translations.idiomatic: Tang established the Protectorate General of Annan.

sentences.zh: 宋時郡人李公蘊立國於此。

translations.literal: In Song times the prefectural native Li Gongyun founded a state here.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song the local magnate Li Gongyun founded a state here.

sentences.zh: 及陳氏立，以其屬地置龍興、天長、長安府。

translations.literal: When the Chen house established its rule, its subordinate lands were organized as Longxing, Tianchang, and Chang'an prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chen dynasty took power, its domains were organized as Longxing, Tianchang, and Chang'an prefectures.

translations.literal: When the Chen house held the state, Longxing Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen established Longxing Prefecture when they ruled the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 天長府，本多墨鄉，陳氏祖父所生之地。

translations.literal: Tianchang Prefecture: originally Duomo township, the birthplace of the Chen clan's forefathers.
translations.idiomatic: Tianchang Prefecture: originally Duomo township, birthplace of the Chen founders.

sentences.zh: 建行宮於此，歲一至，示不忘本，故改曰天長。

translations.literal: A traveling palace was built here; the ruler came once each year to show he did not forget his origins, hence the change of name to Tianchang.
translations.idiomatic: A royal lodge was built here; the ruler visited yearly to honor his origins, hence the name Tianchang ('Long Day').

sentences.zh: 長安府，本華閭洞，丁部領所生之地。

translations.literal: Chang'an Prefecture: originally Hualü Cave, the birthplace of Ding Buling.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an Prefecture: originally Hualü Cave, birthplace of Ding Buling.

translations.literal: At the end of the Five Dynasties Buling founded a state here.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Five Dynasties Buling founded his kingdom here.

translations.literal: Guihua River Route: its land adjoins Yunnan.
Xuanhua River Route: its land adjoins the Temo Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanhua River Route: borders the Temo Circuit.

translations.literal: Tuojiang River Route: its land adjoins Jinchi.

sentences.zh: 諒州江路，地接左右兩江。

translations.literal: Liang Prefecture River Route: its land adjoins the Left and Right Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Prefecture River Route: borders the Left and Right Rivers.

sentences.zh: 北江路，在羅城東岸，瀘江水分入北江，江有六橋。

translations.literal: Beijiang Route: on the east bank of Luocheng; Lujiang River water divides and enters the Beijiang; the river has six bridges.
translations.idiomatic: Beijiang Route: on Luocheng's east bank, where the Lu River splits into the Beijiang; six bridges span the river.

sentences.zh: 此以下州，多接雲南、廣西界，雖名州，其實洞也。

translations.literal: From here downward the prefectures mostly adjoin the Yunnan and Guangxi borders; though called prefectures, they are in fact cave domains.
translations.idiomatic: Below this point most 'prefectures' border Yunnan and Guangxi; though named prefectures, they were in fact tribal cave domains.

sentences.zh: 此以下縣，接雲南、廣西界，雖名縣，其實洞也。

translations.literal: From here downward the counties adjoin the Yunnan and Guangxi borders; though called counties, they are in fact cave domains.
translations.idiomatic: Below this point most 'counties' border Yunnan and Guangxi; though named counties, they were in fact tribal cave domains.
Qinghua Prefecture Route: the Han Jiuzhen commandery.

translations.literal: Under Sui and Tang it was Ai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui and Tang it was Ai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其屬邑更號曰江、曰場、曰甲、曰社。

translations.literal: Its subordinate settlements were renamed jiang, chang, jia, and she.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinate settlements were renamed jiang, chang, jia, and she.
Yi'an Prefecture Route: the Han Rinan commandery.

translations.literal: Under Sui and Tang it was Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui and Tang it was Huan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 演州路，本日南屬縣，曰扶演、安仁。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture Route: originally subordinate counties of Rinan, called Fuyan and Anren.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture Route: originally Rinan subordinate counties Fuyan and Anren.

translations.literal: Under Tang it was changed to Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 布政府路，本日南郡象林縣，東濱海，西際真蠟，南接扶南，北連九德。

translations.literal: Buzheng Prefecture Route: originally Xianglin County of Rinan commandery; east it bordered the sea, west it reached Zhenla, south it adjoined Funan, north it connected Jiude.
translations.idiomatic: Buzheng Prefecture Route: originally Xianglin County in Rinan; east on the sea, west to Zhenla, south to Funan, north to Jiude.

sentences.zh: 東漢末，區連殺象林令，自立國，稱林邑。

translations.literal: At the end of Eastern Han, Qu Lian killed the magistrate of Xianglin, established his own state, and called it Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: In late Eastern Han Qu Lian killed the Xianglin magistrate, set up an independent state, and called it Linyi.

sentences.zh: 唐時有環王者，徙國於占，曰占城。

translations.literal: Under Tang there was a king named Huan; he moved the state to Zhan and called it Champa.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang King Huan moved the capital to Zhan and renamed the realm Champa.

translations.literal: Present Buzheng is the old territory of Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: Present-day Buzheng was old Linyi territory.

sentences.zh: 自安南大羅城至燕京，約一百一十五驛，計七千七百餘里。

translations.literal: From Annam's Daluocheng to Yanjing there are about one hundred fifteen relay stages, totaling more than seven thousand seven hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: From Annam's Daluocheng to Yanjing is about 115 relay stages—roughly 7,700 li.
Border peoples subject to corvée service.
